phases.cert_alignment: consolidation ground that maps onto Security+'s General Security Concepts and ISC2 CC's Security Principles and Network Security domains — the "what even is security" and "how does a network work" baseline every later cloud and detection skill assumes.

phases.title: Scripting for Cloud Security
phases.cert_alignment: not a named cert domain, but the quiet enabler behind every cloud security role — the boto3 audit scripting here is exactly the automation AWS's own Security Specialty assumes you can do, and the PowerShell maps onto Windows log work in CySA+/Security+ Security Operations.

phases.cert_alignment: maps directly onto AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) and the IAM, Infrastructure Security and Data Protection domains of AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C02) — IAM being the single largest Specialty domain, which is why this phase over-invests there.

phases.title: The Attacker's View (light)
phases.cert_alignment: touches eJPT and CEH reconnaissance/scanning/web content, but taught for recognition rather than tradecraft — the real payoff is the detection view, which feeds CySA+ Vulnerability Management and the hunting work in Phase 6.

phases.title: Windows, AD & Logs
phases.cert_alignment: the Windows event-log and Active Directory detection content is core CySA+ and Security+ Security Operations material — most enterprise telemetry a hunter reads is Windows and AD, so this is read-the-logs knowledge, not attack knowledge.

phases.cert_alignment: the heart of the roadmap and, almost domain for domain, CompTIA CySA+ (Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Incident Response) plus the Detection and Incident Response domains of AWS Security – Specialty. This is where the cloud-hunting skill is actually built.
